setup: # 1. Toolchain preconditions from AGENTS.md — fail loud, don't half-set-up a worktree.
command -v go >/dev/null || { echo "go not on PATH"; exit 1; }
go version | grep -qE 'go1\.(2[6-9]|[3-9][0-9])' || { echo "need Go 1.26+, got $(go version)"; exit 1; }
# tsgo is a *global* npm install; nvm's shims are often absent in non-login shells.
tsgo --version >/dev/null || { echo "tsgo unusable; internal/lsp + Tier A will SKIP"; exit 1; }
# 2. Module + build cache are shared globally, so this is a near no-op on warm machines
#    and the only real fetch step on a cold one.
# 3. Warm compile so the first agent command in the worktree isn't a 60s build.
